rules.QQQ: monthly QQQ by default; if QQQ DD<=-15% AND QQQ>=MA200, existing QQQ 90%->TQQQ once/cycle and monthly->TQQQ; TQQQ exits at frozen pre-entry own ATH; T+1
rules.VOO: monthly VOO/SSO/UPRO at >-14% / -14%~-32% / <=-32%; existing VOO remains untouched in SSO zone; DD<=-32% existing VOO 90%->UPRO once/cycle; SSO stays; own prior-ATH exits; T+1

actions.title: 월 적립금 → QQQ
